description: This file declares the HealthcheckService class, which implements the IHealthcheckService interface. It manages health check pings for servers, including sending pings, handling acknowledgments, and removing servers. It references external interfaces such as ISessionServerAppManager, ITimer, and ITimerFactory, and uses standard C++ features like smart pointers, mutexes, and sets.

classes.description: Implements server health check logic, managing ping sending and server status updates.
